title: Implement background process-tree resource hard-stop
notes: Implemented ResourceSampler.sample_process_tree(pid) to recursively aggregate RSS memory, CPU%, and threads across root process and all recursive children.
Integrated asynchronous background monitor task in QAController._resource_monitor_loop running every config.resources.sample_seconds.
Breaches of resources.hard_stop_rss_mb immediately trigger active action cancellation and transition controller to STOPPING / COMPLETED.
